description: Defines the CsrfTokenGenerator class for generating and validating CSRF tokens within Drupal, utilizing session metadata, private keys, and site settings.

classes.name: CsrfTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and validating CSRF tokens based on session data, private keys, and site settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CsrfTokenGenerator with private key and session metadata dependencies.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Generates a CSRF token based on session seed and optional value.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given CSRF token against the session seed and optional value.

methods.name: computeToken
methods.description: Computes a CSRF token using HMAC with session seed, optional value, private key, and site hash salt.
